definitions.explanation: An ordinary employee with no managerial title or special position. The lowest rank in a company hierarchy.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{平社員|ひらしゃいん}です。
⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{平社員|ひらしゃいん}だ。
examples.english: He's been with the company for ten years and is still a regular employee.

examples.japanese: {平社員|ひらしゃいん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was promoted from a regular employee all the way to department head.

notes:
{平|ひら} (ordinary, flat) + ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧ (employee). Refers to a regular employee with no managerial title — the bottom rung of the corporate ladder.

REGISTER:
Often used with a self-deprecating or humble nuance. Saying ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{平社員|ひらしゃいん}です implies one hasn't been promoted yet.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {平社員|ひらしゃいん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be promoted from a regular employee
- ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{平社員|ひらしゃいん}: still just a regular employee
- {平社員|ひらしゃいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: remaining a regular employee

JAPANESE CORPORATE HIERARCHY (bottom to top):
- {平社員|ひらしゃいん} → ⟦{主任|しゅにん}→主任：08211_shunin⟧ → ⟦{係長|かかりちょう}→係長：08212_kakarichou⟧ → ⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧ → ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧ → ⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧ → ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧
